Annual Report 2024

1. Executive Summary
The company achieved strong growth in all regions. Revenue increased by 23% year over year. We expanded our product line and entered two new markets.

2. Financial Highlights
Total revenue: $450M. Operating margin: 18%. Cash flow from operations was positive. We repurchased 2M shares during the year.

3. Operations
Manufacturing capacity was expanded. Quality metrics improved. Supply chain resilience initiatives were completed. Employee headcount grew by 12%.

4. Outlook
We expect mid-single-digit revenue growth in the coming year. Margins should remain stable. Capital expenditure will focus on automation.
